amendments: Freeze this version and its receipt before outcomes. Any material change needs a new version, digest, rationale and prospective receipt. Mark already inspected contrasts exploratory.
ordering: Read accepted evidence; screen matched one-factor changes inside each outer training set; lock each shared contract jointly before selecting arm-specific settings; score once on its outer partition. Stop on insufficient evidence, time or fits. No Cartesian search.

uncertainty.method: Paired percentile intervals, common resampled row IDs within outer-fold by true-class strata. Recompute the metric on each pooled paired draw. Primary family comprises LR, MLP, EBM and XGB log-loss plus Pass 1 and Pass 2 coverage for each router. Two-sided Bonferroni 99.375% per endpoint even if slots go unused. Fixed finalist procedures only. All screen, secondary and transfer intervals descriptive 95%. Report five paired fold effects and their SD; intervals condition on fitted streams and prevalence. No independent-validation claim.
uncertainty.minimum: Require both classes, complete paired rows and all five evaluation folds; at least 20 of each class per evaluated fold/subset. Report under-supported strata with counts. For chronological evidence require all five PR 42 windows, both classes and the same 20-per-class floor; intervals for the unweighted mean of window metrics resample within window and class.

loss1.benefit: reference minus candidate calibrated log-loss, all rows
loss1.basis: About 0.7% of Stage 1 baseline loss (0.287–0.292). Prospective practical tolerance, not an estimated sampling error.

loss3.benefit: reference minus candidate calibrated log-loss, arm's frozen deferrals
loss3.basis: Frozen GLASS deferred Stage 1 to Stage 3 loss gap is about 0.0025 on the Step 2A scale; black-box gap about 0.0032. A 0.002 change recovers a substantial part of either historical gap.

route.benefit: candidate minus reference routing share; compare Pass 1 first, Pass 2 second on all common rows
route.basis: Half a percentage point is about 165 training contacts. Use separate intervals for each pass. Examine Pass 2 for promotion only after Pass 1 equivalence; Pass 2 cannot compensate for worse or unresolved Pass 1.

diagnostic.benefit: reference minus candidate whole-system policy loss at locked actions
diagnostic.basis: PR 43 review-cost scale. Descriptive improvement/equivalence only; cannot confer adoption.

decision.interval: Orient all primary effects as benefit. Improved if lower bound > margin. Comparable if entire interval is inside inclusive +/-margin. Reject for upper bound < -margin or a known mandatory safeguard failure. All other intervals, inadequate support, missing prerequisite or exhausted budget: inconclusive. Failed mandatory safeguards take precedence. No advancement by one-sided noninferiority alone.
decision.tie: On comparability prefer, in order, removal of an unavailable-label dependency, fewer learned features/terms, then at least 20% lower matched wall time; otherwise retain the reference. Finalists for both router endpoints must be chosen using fitting-local evidence before outer scoring; individual contract alternatives are secondary. For routers require both passes comparable before using the tie-break. For a Pass 1 improvement still require Pass 2 obligations.
decision.probability_guards: For promotion, pooled all-row AP and ROC-AUC may fall at most 0.010 and 0.005 respectively, calibrated Brier may rise at most 0.002 and ECE must be <=0.05. Apply AP/Brier/ECE also to the frozen served subset for Stage 3. These are point safeguards; report their descriptive paired intervals. PR 42 used these scale-specific ranking/calibration guards. Invalid fitting boundaries or persistent numerical instability reject.
decision.feature_guards: PR 42 fixed versus reselected interactions moved net corrections from 486 to 389 against 456.86 on the historical mask. Recompute the paired control floor for each new block. A shared Stage 3 revision must qualify on both arms; verify G2/G3 and feature order. For EBM apply the complete PR 42 Step 5A simplification criteria including ROC lower bound >=-0.010, nested F2 delta >=-0.010, documented interpretability gain and net corrections >= paired refit net minus 0.005 times fixed deferrals. Plot only supported shapes and verify additive term reconstruction on raw link scale within 1e-8 absolute. No unsupported shape-based tie-break.
decision.chrono_guard: R1 requires a valid cold-start rule, same-day/future-label flip invariance and the lower descriptive 95% bound on mean within-window candidate-minus-accepted AP >=-0.010. Report pooled results separately. Unknown outcome delay limits lag-zero claims. This is a candidate safeguard, not chronological cascade validation.
decision.router_guards: Use shared/stage2/contracts/stage2_primary_v1.json and PR 38 evaluation protocol. Fit-time support 125/75; Pass 1 NPV >=0.95 and positive leakage <=0.15; Pass 2 precision >=0.30 on its actual eligible remainder. Preserve exact count arithmetic, lexicographic objective, G13, M3/M4 and F31. Report outer violations and exact shortfalls by fold and pooled; require pooled obligations and no new fold-level violation relative to the paired control. Unsupported evaluations are inconclusive. Unproven incumbents require status, gap documentation and matching ordered re-solve per M3; no silent fallback.
decision.support_transfer: For independent symbolic confidence transfer require >=100 independent first-issued observations of that identical rule in each of two inner folds. Report matches, issued positives, overlap, order, base rate, marginal coverage, rule recurrence and all route transitions. Unsupported transfer stays unavailable.

nesting.procedure: Reuse the shared five-fold outer plan and FoldPlan within outer training for both learners to pair results and bound cost. Historical Stage 1 ten-fold and Stage 2/3 five-fold OOF tables remain descriptive controls. Refit comparator and candidate on identical research partitions. Each inner evaluation also gets its own training-only three-subfold OOF calibration stream. Refit the chosen base model on its fitting pool; fit the calibration map on that pool's OOF scores. Use the same isolated streams for calibrated/raw reporting. Calibrator family and reference procedure are frozen from the accepted arm.
nesting.screen_population: Each candidate fit trains independently of the router. Use inner all-row log-loss for Stage 1 and conditional deferred-row log-loss for Stage 3 to screen feature/training changes. For R6 order ties by fewer terms. Fitting-local screens and each extra seed count toward T. Keep the matched control and all fixed alternatives in the declared order. A cap that prevents the required comparison yields inconclusive. A conditional option can enter only within the fold that triggers it.
nesting.selection: Screen one-factor proposals in listed order. Start from the accepted settings. For each family retain the best inner primary loss among safeguard-passing options (within 0.002 choose the registered simplicity order, then list order). Freeze each family choice before the next. For Stage 3 objective comparisons rank the same model proposals separately by F2 at 0.5, log-loss and AP using fitting-local inner validation scores; choosing an objective is itself an inner decision. Use cross-fitted decisions for cuts. No global screening on future outer rows. Repeat all adaptive steps per outer fold.
nesting.shared_lock: Within each outer training partition compare the shared revision with the accepted contract at fixed reference learner/router settings, using the already budgeted matched fitting-local evidence. Use the same fold plan and row identities for the two arms; each Stage 3 arm retains its own frozen deferral mask. Apply the registered safeguards and the following inner point rules separately per arm. No pooling, offsetting an arm loss, or inspecting outer scores. Record both arm decisions and one contract definition digest for the fold before arm-specific tuning. Enforce that digest at both outer fits; a mismatch invalidates the comparison.
nesting.R5_lock: At fixed training settings, qualify jed_alone per arm on a deferred log-loss benefit >0.002, or within +/-0.002 with the registered simplicity tie-break. Apply the applicable feature and probability safeguards on fitting-local evidence. Require both arms to qualify. Otherwise use the accepted shared feature list for both. Select EBM interactions and each learner's settings only within that locked block; these choices cannot change its ordered features.
nesting.R3_lock: Only the fold-local gap_placed procedure can replace frozen bins; registered reference constants remain a sensitivity comparison. On fitting-local independently issued routes for each arm, apply router safeguards and compare coverage benefits lexicographically: Pass 1 >0.005 qualifies; within +/-0.005 inspect Pass 2, requiring >0.005 or comparability within +/-0.005 and the registered simplicity tie-break. Both arms must qualify. Lock the same ordered 29-bin definition, reference scope and fitting procedure; fit cut values only on each authorized fitting partition. R4 affects GLASS rules only; RF tuning cannot change the bin contract. If either arm lacks eligible inner evidence, including Pass 2 coverage, retain frozen bins for both and record R3 as inconclusive. Do not substitute fit-sample coverage or add a nested router sweep.
nesting.handoff: Joint locks may differ by outer fold. The eight outer endpoints evaluate the prespecified selection procedures, not any one contract used in a subset of folds. Report contract identities/frequencies and paired outer outcomes for both arms. A shared revision needs qualifying outer procedures on both arms and a common deployment contract chosen by the same joint rule on full training-side fitting-local evidence. Reuse compatible evidence within existing caps; if unavailable, defer the revision. Never select the deployment contract by outer-fold wins.
nesting.R1_R2_roles: Report R1 encoding and R2 stopping as separate one-factor descriptive screens with matched controls and fitting-local scores. For MLP compare encodings at fixed isolated stopping; compare stopping procedures at fixed accepted features, settings and seed. The historical stopping path is reference-only. For LR compare encodings at fixed LR settings. Record encoding eligibility and stopping isolation separately. Require R1's chronological gate for adoption; the separate five-window check may veto advancement after random-fold locks but must never feed evaluation labels into those locks. Only the final combined LR procedure and the final combined MLP procedure each receive one registered outer all-row log-loss contrast against their own matched accepted-procedure refit. Neither an isolated R1/R2 effect nor an LR-versus-MLP difference is a primary endpoint.
nesting.isolation: Partition raw row IDs first. Fit target encodings, scaling, weights/resampling, pair search, thresholds, calibration and stopping only on applicable fitting rows. Split internal stopping rows before feature or resampling fits. For learned stopping lengths refit on the authorized pool with count locked. Cache key includes ordered fit/eval IDs, labels, seed, procedure and feature version. Report disjoint IDs, selected parameters, fit sizes and signed inner-selected minus outer-evaluated metrics in original units. The gap includes sampling and fit-size effects.
nesting.scope: All-row OOF quality, quality on own frozen deferrals, and outer performance of the nested learner are distinct. A frozen router may have trained on labels in later Stage 3 evaluation partitions. Even nested Stage 3 served-row evaluation remains conditional. Different arms' served populations are not matched. PR 49 owns fully nested stacking sensitivity, lagged outcomes and chronological cascades.

contrasts.control: accepted three macro features and accepted settings
contrasts.extra: Paired random folds plus five PR 42 chronological windows; report fallback frequency. Apply chrono_guard.

contrasts.control: accepted early-stop preprocessing at matched features and initialization
contrasts.extra: Historical shared-encoder path is a labelled reference only. For comparability isolate the stopping subset using the accepted fraction and matched seed. Use isolated stopping for all candidate selection.

Use compatible penalties only. Diagnose all seven historical warnings on their original configurations; standardized inputs, then repeat capped fits at 2x accepted max_iter with fixed tolerance. Log fold, cap, n_iter, coefficients and probabilities. Reject a retained fit that still warns or changes a probability by >0.001 on doubling the cap.

contrasts.trigger: Open one architecture/optimizer alternative in listed order only if fitting-local seed range in log-loss exceeds 0.002 or training reaches its iteration cap. Recheck survivors at seeds 42 and 43. No architecture grid.

contrasts.extra: Pair probabilities on identical rows; report log-loss, AP, ROC-AUC, Brier and existing ten-bin ECE. Register raw calibration contrast as secondary; use calibrated primary for finalist.

contrasts.control: matched refit of shared accepted 13-feature block
space: jed_alone with fixed surviving Step 5A pairs for EBM
contrasts.extra: Use own frozen deferrals; shared-contract decision requires both arms. Keep reference if either arm is inconclusive.

contrasts.control: three fixed original pairs on baseline; two eligible fixed pairs on jed_alone
contrasts.extra: Screen PR 42 selector inside each fitting partition; check feature_guards, supported shapes and the paired net-corrections screen.

contrasts.control: accepted balanced training and F2-at-0.5 search
contrasts.extra: Change search objective and fitting weights separately. Optimize inner selection on the arm's fixed serving mask while fitting stages independently on training rows. Also report full training population.
One-factor alternatives. Report term count and supported fold shape variability.

space: early stopping: patience 20, cap 2x count, stratified 15% fit-local validation
contrasts.extra: Refit with selected tree count locked; track stopping overhead and count stability.

contrasts.control: frozen cuts and matched router settings
contrasts.extra: Registered constants exposed to outer rows are sensitivity only. Check fold-0 migration, cut provenance, first-issued precision and feasibility on each arm.

contrasts.control: same bins and original GLASS Pass 2 rules
contrasts.trigger: Combine only after both individual revisions pass fitting safeguards and improve inner Pass 1 or, at comparable Pass 1, Pass 2 coverage by >=0.005. No outer-result-driven search.
Only under a changed eligible bin contract or repeated inner OOF pass-obligation shortfall in at least two folds. Reuse accepted threshold selection under the same obligations.

contrasts.control: verified frozen upstream and locked common-policy controls
space: one shortlisted stream at a time
contrasts.extra: Before results, bind exact ordered row, label, producing-fold, flag, score-space, threshold, candidate and companion digests in a new F10 receipt. Reject stale fingerprints. Use common frozen masks first, then actual router deferrals with class mix. No production regeneration.

contrasts.control: same rows, locked cuts and unchanged companions
conditional: full versus fold-averaged shortlisted producer, fixed accepted 4305 split
contrasts.trigger: Only if a changed stream produces absolute coverage or class-retention movement >=0.05, policy loss movement >=0.005, or retained symbolic confidence lacks independent support. Use existing fitting/holdout streams if compatible; at most one changed producer per arm.

conditional: one same-family three-input LR student on 50:50 cross-fitted teacher and true-label targets
contrasts.trigger: Only for a documented scoring-cost bottleneck (>2x matched simpler model time), compatible fitting-local teacher predictions and spare transfer allowance. Report true-label loss, calibration, fidelity, size and explanation separately. Exploratory only. Defer cross-family distillation, focal loss, RL and bandits.

cost_model.anchors: The estimates include time for feature construction and numerical checks; preflight elapsed time can shorten the executable list. PR 43 simulated holdout: LR/MLP 12.96/252.22 s for 111 fits, EBM/XGB 355.59/173.23 s for 31 fits, GLASS/RF routers 4945.19/377.45 s for six primary routers (GLASS includes M3, RF 222 forests). Extrapolated times are estimates; changes in feature engineering, solver termination, hardware and stopping can dominate.
cost_model.learners: Per outer fold budget T distinct proposals including control, compared over three inner folds, plus two locked outer fits (candidate and matched comparator). Three calibration subfits plus a base refit per evaluation: 4*(3*T+2)*5 base fits. One calibration map per four fits; at most one extra stopping refit per base fit for MLP/XGB, charged to hard cap. Every new encoder, block or EBM pair-selection call is counted; at most one per base fit per component, reuse only under identical keys. Conditional second seeds count as distinct trials. Reserve five windows x two arms of a contrast x four fits = 40 additional base fits per Stage 1 learner. Budgets include failed attempts.
cost_model.routers: One complete router fit per configuration per outer fold. Perform fit-only fold-0 preflight; reuse only if scope matches. GLASS budget reserves one M3 repeat per eligible selection, up to five nested Pass 1 plus final Pass 1/2 selections per router (7 initial + 7 repeats; up to two CBC phases per selection). Record actual ILP solves per selection, elapsed time and status; stop if any cap would be exceeded. RF historical planning rate 37 forest fits/router. Cap all nested forests. Favor cached frozen control when compatible.
cost_model.stop: Hard caps apply per arm across all listed contrasts, including failures and diagnostic fits. Check remaining fits and wall time before dispatch, pass remaining wall time to interruptible jobs; stop incomplete work at deadline. Budget failure is inconclusive. Remove duplicate proposals. Required contrasts take priority over conditional expansion; no borrowing from another arm.

transfer_budget: Frozen individual and combined substitutions cost zero training fits. Conditional fits: one producer type per arm, <=111 Stage 1 or <=31 Stage 3 base fits or <=6 routers per arm. Router work also consumes the router arm's remaining M3/forest and time allowance. Advanced screen <=20 student fits within the same cap. Reserve cutoff and companion-model fitting for PR 45; if compatible locked controls cannot be applied, mark unavailable.
system: Apply PR 43 policy v1 loss (FP + 2 FN + 0.25 reviews)/N and its sensitivity costs, class retention floors and exact attainable tie groups on matched locked actions. Controls: original GLASS formula and raw Meta on each upstream, normalized GLASS margins only on GLASS. Report signed voter margins, agreement, unique correct decisions, effective recall, retained prevalence, coverage, per-class retention, gross flips and net changes in decisions/retention and router transition counts. Treat as descriptive development evidence; PR 45 owns adoption, PR 47 formal comparison.
